nora: Heads up — Zendesk #45218. User reports Analytics CSV export returns an empty file after applying a segmentation filter and a custom date range. They tried both Chrome and Edge.

sophia: Thanks, Nora. Can you paste their repro steps / the exact segment name and date window? Also which workspace/org?

nora: Copying from ticket: Segment = "Paid - monthly"; Date range = 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28; Route: Analytics > Sessions > Export CSV. They click Export, browser downloads .csv but file size is 0 bytes. User attached screenshot showing 0 KB file. Org: acme-prod (acct id masked).

support-bot: Ticket #45218 marked P2 and assigned to @eng-analytics.

mike: I can take a look. Do we have an export-id or network log? Ask user to open DevTools Network tab and re-download, then share the request/response headers. Could be 204 / empty body or a content-encoding mismatch.

nora: Asked them for HAR / request id. They replied with request id: export_20260228_9982. They said the exporter endpoint returned status 200 but Content-Length: 0.

jordan: If Content-Length: 0 but 200, likely one of two things: streaming generator emitted no chunks, or a middle proxy stripped the body. Any recent platform changes?

mike: There's a recent change in streaming CSV generator (rollout 2026-02-25) that short-circuits when row_count == 0 to avoid allocating buffers. Edge case: when segment evaluation errors, we send an early empty response instead of a 500. I'll try to reproduce locally.

mike: Quick repro attempt steps I'm running:
```
# simulate export with segment filter
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  "https://console.redwood/api/analytics/export?segment=paid-monthly&start=2026-02-01&end=2026-02-28&format=csv" -v -o out.csv
```

mike: Locally I get a 200 with a 0 byte file when the segment evaluation throws an internal filter exception (we were swallowing the exception). Repro is consistent with their request id.

sophia: Oof. Can we provide a workaround for the customer while we fix?

mike: Workarounds: 1) Export as JSON (Analytics > Export > JSON) — that returns records. 2) Remove the segment filter and export, then run segmentation client-side. 3) Use API with page_size param to avoid the streaming shortcut: append `&page_size=1` to force generator to yield at least one chunk (temporary).

nora: Sent workarounds to customer. They said JSON export works but they need CSV for downstream pipeline. They accepted temporary `page_size` trick.

jordan: I'll open a hotfix PR to ensure we return 500 on segment evaluation errors (so support can see failure) and also avoid returning 200 empty body. Will add a retry/backstop that emits CSV header even if rows==0 so file isn't zero-bytes.

mike: Note on encoding: customer also mentioned Excel shows mojibake when they open CSV in Excel (even when not empty). We add a UTF-8 BOM for Excel compatibility in dedicated CSV export path. The BOM change is separate; the streaming change introduced the empty-file bug.

jordan: PR #4214 drafted, testing now. Changes: ensure generator writes header row first, always send Content-Length: chunked (Transfer-Encoding: chunked) for streaming, and surface internal errors as 5xx. Adding integration test for segment + empty-result behavior.

analytics-bot: Deploy queued: eng-analytics/hotfix/4214 -> staging at 2026-03-01T02:00Z.

mike: After deploy, please confirm with the original request id. If still failing, we'll capture full server logs for that request id.

sophia: Noted. I updated Zendesk with ETA and the page_size workaround. Customer responded :thumbsup: and will try again after the staging deploy.

nora: Closing loop: we should also add an observability alert for exports that return 200 with Content-Length: 0. Could catch regressions earlier.

jordan: Agreed — will add a metric `export_zero_byte_count` and a low-volume alert.

mike: PR merged to main after tests. Hotfix deploy scheduled to prod tomorrow. Leaving this thread open until post-deploy verification with the user.

sophia: Thanks all, nice triage.

nora: (after prod deploy) Customer confirmed CSV download now contains header + rows and Excel opens correctly. Marking resolved. :tada:
